name: TET Rezekne regional data center listing
notes: Only aggregate marketplace evidence found; Cloudscene lists a Rezekne regional facility operated by TET with one provider. No operator page with facility details found in this pass.

name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC1
notes: Operator says the AI/HPC facility is launched, operational and available for customer deployments; 10 MW, 1000 racks, address Cuibes Street 17, Riga, with owned land allowing scale-up to 30 MW.

name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC2
notes: Operator data-center portfolio lists Riga LV DC2 at Cuibes Street 17 with 2 MW power, 240 racks, up to 10 kW/rack and EN 50600-3 design.

name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC3
notes: Operator data-center portfolio lists Riga LV DC3 as Delska's first underground data center at Jana Asara Street 24, with 1 MW power and 80 racks.

name: Tet Data Center Dattum
notes: Tet Cloud operator page lists Dattum as a Tier III facility for critical IT systems with 100 racks, 1.4 MW, PCI DSS Level 1 and 100% availability since launch in 2013.

name: Tet Data Center Brivibas
notes: Tet Cloud operator page lists Brivibas as a Tier III-designed critical IT systems facility with 50 racks and 0.7 MW.

name: Tet Data Center Kleistu
notes: Tet Cloud operator page lists Kleistu on a Tet main network infrastructure node with 122 racks and 1.2 MW.

name: Tet Data Center Perses
notes: Tet Cloud operator page lists Perses as a carrier-neutral telecom and internet traffic exchange data center with 80 racks and 0.7 MW.

name: Tet Data Center Atlasa
notes: Tet Cloud operator page lists Atlasa as a carrier-neutral data center built to ANSI/TIA-942 and Tier III specification, with 40 cabinets up to 15 kW each; total MW not stated.

name: Tet DC 6
notes: Tet Cloud operator page lists Tet DC 6 at Kleistu Street 5, Riga, with Tier III security design, 60 racks and 0.3 MW electric power.

name: Tet DC7 Salaspils
notes: DCD reports Tet broke ground May 29, 2025 on DC7 in Salaspils southeast of Riga; 112 racks by 2026 and 224 racks at full buildout by end-2028, EUR30m investment, liquid cooling and waste-heat reuse. Included under Riga division because source describes it as outside/southeast of the capital and Latvia's market is Riga-clustered.

name: LVRTC TV Tower data center
developer: Latvian State Radio and Television Center (LVRTC)
notes: LVRTC operator page says it offers data-center colocation in Riga and nationwide; PeeringDB identifies the Riga TV Tower as LVRTC's largest Tier III-built data center and a major Latvian colocation/interconnection facility with more than 40 operators.

name: LVRTC Talejas iela 1 data center
developer: Latvian State Radio and Television Center (LVRTC)
notes: PeeringDB lists Talejas iela 1 as an LVRTC Riga facility; LVRTC says it operates data-center services in Riga and across Latvia. Capacity not disclosed in public source.

name: LVRTC Ventspils RTS
developer: Latvian State Radio and Television Center (LVRTC)
notes: PeeringDB lists LVRTC Ventspils RTS as an LVRTC facility in Ventspils; ColoMap describes it as a colocation data center at Gertrudes iela 18. Operator page confirms LVRTC provides nationwide colocation possibilities every 100 km.

name: LVRTC Positron Kurzeme secure data center
developer: Latvian State Radio and Television Center (LVRTC)
notes: Operator announced construction of Positron, a high-performance secure data center in Kurzeme more than 150 km from Riga, expected available to customers in early 2027. Exact municipality was not public in the sources reviewed; included with Ventspils division as a Kurzeme-coast coverage item, not as a confirmed Ventspils-city site.
